Commentary.Commentary: For UAE it was not the best days with the ball! Except for Ali Naseer all their bowlers took a pounding. Ali Naseer was excellent but he hardly recieved any support from the other end. Their batters now face a huge task. Lanka have an excellent bowling attack and UAE will have to bat out of their skin if they are to chase it down. Can they come close? We will find out.

End of a power-packed batting performance from the Lankans! A brave call but we believe, they have batted UAE out of the game. The openers laid the platform with a 95-run stand. Sadeera Samarawickrama then continued the good work once Dimuth Karunaratne fell. Kusal Mendis did not let the momentum slip away after he came in. At one stage, 375 looked possible for the Lankans but there was a period in the middle overs where they lost a few wickets quickly. Wanindu Hasaranga and Charith Asalanka though batted brilliantly and took them above the 350-run mark.
A single to end but a very good last over! On middle, this is heaved through mid-wicket for one. SRI LANKA END WITH 355!

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. It is time for the national anthems first. It will be the UAE's first followed by of the Lankans. All done with the pre-match proceedings. It is time for action. Pathum Nissanka and Dimuth Karunaratne to open for the Lankans. Muhammad Jawadullah to bowl first. Let's go...

United Arab Emirates (PLAYING XI) - Muhammad Waseem (C), Ali Naseer, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Rohan Mustafa, Basil Hameed, Asif Khan, Rameez Shahzad, Aayan Khan, Karthik Meiyappan, Zahoor Khan, Muhammad Jawadullah.

Sri Lanka (PLAYING XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Dimuth Karunaratne, Kusal Mendis (WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Maheesh Theekshana, Kasun Rajitha, Lahiru Kumara.

Dasun Shanaka says they would have bowled first. Adds the wicket was a bit tricky in the warm-up games but feels this one is a better wicket. Reckons the spinners will come into play later on. Informs Dushmantha Chameera is not fit for the game.

Muhammad Waseem says they will bowl first. Feels there is some moisture on the pitch and hopes to restrict Sri Lanka to a low total. Shares the preparations have been going really well and hopes to continue with the momentum.
TOSS - United Arab Emirates have won the toss and will BOWL.

Hello and welcome to the action of World Cup Qualifiers where we shift our attention to Group B as Sri Lanka will be taking on United Arab Emirates. Only two spots are available to go through and Sri Lanka are one of the favourties to book one. They will be up against United Arab Emirates who have shown in the recent past that they can beat the big boys but they need to put their best foot forward as Sri Lanka are coming with some good performance on their back. Who do you think will win? Toss and team news coming up.
